en.headline: Elderly couple found dead at Kwai Chung Estate in suspected murder-suicide
en.dek: Police are investigating after an elderly man was found outside a residential block and a woman with multiple wounds was discovered inside their flat on Sunday night.
body: An elderly couple were found dead at Chun Kwai House in Kwai Chung Estate late on Sunday night in what police are treating as a suspected murder-suicide.

Shortly after 11 pm, officers responded to a report of a man lying motionless outside the block. The man, believed to be in his eighties, was pronounced dead at the scene. Police then entered the couple’s high-floor flat and discovered the body of a woman in her sixties who had multiple injuries consistent with wounds from a sharp instrument. She was also pronounced dead at the scene.

The pair were husband and wife who lived together in the unit. The case has been classified as murder and suicide and handed to the district crime squad for further investigation. Both bodies were removed to the mortuary for post-mortem examination. The building was cordoned off while forensic work continued.

zh.headline: 葵涌邨春葵樓雙屍案 八旬翁墮樓 六旬婦伏屍單位內
zh.dek: 警方正調查一宗懷疑謀殺及自殺案，周日晚一名八旬男子倒臥大廈外，單位內發現一名六旬女子身上有多處利器傷痕。
body: 葵涌邨春葵樓周日晚發生一宗雙屍案，警方正以謀殺及自殺跟進調查。
昨晚約11時後，警方接報一名男子倒臥大廈對開，初步相信他由高處墮下，當場證實死亡，死者相信為八十多歲。警員其後進入該對夫婦居住的高層單位，發現一名六十多歲女子伏屍，身上有多處懷疑由利器造成的傷痕，同樣當場證實死亡。
兩名死者為夫婦關係，同住該單位。案件已交由區刑事調查隊跟進，遺體送往殮房候驗，大廈現場已圍封進行法證工作。
